title: KABİS notifications
description: Police (KABİS) notifications of actual handovers and returns: attempt history, result and staff reconciliation.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view KABİS notifications.
load_failed: KABİS notifications could not be loaded.
empty_description: A notification appears here when a vehicle is handed over or returned. Reservations are never reported.
official_note_title: Only confirmed records are official notifications
official_note: Every row other than "Reported", "Reported manually" and "Reconciled" is a local record; it does not mean the police were notified.
status_hints.blocked: Nothing was sent because required data is missing. Complete it on the customer / driver / branch record, then press "Check the data again".
status_hints.waiting_dependency: There is no working KABİS connection; nothing was sent and it is not an official notification. Report manually if needed and mark it.
status_hints.pending: The notification has not reached the police yet (local record). After a connection loss it is sent on the next attempt or with "Retry".
status_hints.processing: The notification is being sent right now.
status_hints.submitted: Sent; waiting for the KABİS result. Not an official notification yet.
status_hints.needs_verification: No answer after sending; the result is unknown. The system checks the status before sending anything again. If the check is unclear too, verify in KABİS and mark it "Reconcile".
status_hints.failed: KABİS did not receive or rejected the notification. "Retry" checks the record's status first.
status_hints.succeeded: KABİS received the notification and returned a reference.
status_hints.reported_manually: Staff filed the notification through the official manual channel (reason, reference and attachment recorded).
status_hints.reconciled: Staff confirmed the notification reached KABİS (reason and reference recorded).
status_hints.ignored: No action is needed for this notification.
holds.no_account: No KABİS connection is set up (Settings → Integrations).
holds.adapter_unverified: The official KABİS connection method is not verified yet.
holds.adapter_unavailable: The connected KABİS adapter is not available in this environment.
toast.already_done: KABİS has the record; the notification is marked done.
toast.in_progress: KABİS is processing the record; the result is being followed.
toast.resubmitted: KABİS has no record; the notification was sent again.
missing.name: Name
problems.generic: The action could not be completed.
problems.data_missing: Required data is still missing: {{fields}}. Nothing was sent.
problems.dependency_pending: There is no working KABİS connection; nothing was sent.
problems.unverified: The KABİS status could not be verified; nothing was sent again blindly. Check in KABİS and reconcile.
problems.busy: The notification is being processed; try again shortly.
problems.not_retryable: This notification is complete and cannot be retried.
problems.not_resolvable: This action does not apply to the notification's current state.
validation.reference: The official reference is required (at most 120 characters).
resolve.manual_description: Mark it when the notification was filed through the official manual channel. The system will not send it afterwards.
resolve.reconcile_description: Mark it when you confirmed yourself that the notification reached KABİS. The system will not send it afterwards.
fields.reason_hint: Describe what was done; it goes to the audit log.
fields.attachment_hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP; at most 10 MB.
connection.title: KABİS connection
connection.none_hint: Notifications stay waiting on a dependency and are not sent.
connection.official_hint: Until the official connection method is verified notifications are not sent; report manually if needed and mark them.
connection.fake_hint: Development only: nothing is sent to the police.
detail.title: KABİS notification
detail.people_hint: Identity and licence numbers are masked; the full values are stored encrypted and used only for the notification.
detail.attempts_hint: Every send and status check is its own row.
detail.no_blind_retry: While the result is unknown the system does not resend; it checks the status in KABİS first.
people.columns.name: Name / title
